notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984532/6f382e0e696e3982c43279c4edf5c9356e7104f8.png[/img]

[h1]Gun Fight maps[/h1]

[h3]Soon we will introduce Gunfight only maps[/h3]

Our next release will contain two new maps where you will only be able to use guns.

Rate Up / down if you are looking forward to that or not. ːsteamthumbsupː / ːsteamthumbsdownː

Looking for the big update? Head over to [url=https://www.deceptus.net/voteforstuff]our website[/url] and vote on what the next maps and features should be! We do listen and will release features you vote on! 

Keep on playing! ːsteamhappyː
Hugs from us at TwoGether Studios.

notes.title: Latest Update
notes.content:
Following bugs have been fixed and new improved features added:

[h2][b]Bugs Reported and Status[/b]
[/h2][olist]
[*] Unlocked Maps become locked again. - FIXED

[*] DLC not downloadable nor accessible from in-game Map Menu - FIXED

[*] Achievements not working on Steam - FIXED
[/olist]

[h2][b]Improvements & Features[/b][/h2]
[olist]
[*] Select a Server Region to join or when creating a new game. - FIXED
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984532/b15b718065e8d9d96fa8d8d4f86070d8c40e85e5.png[/img]

[*] Take everyone back to same Lobby after the round is finished. - NOT STARTED

[*] Ability to start a Private Room - NOT STARTED
[/olist]

Feel free to visit our voting page on next maps, next features and more. We keep updating our Web page. Website link [https://www.deceptus.net/voteforstuff]

[url=https://www.deceptus.net/voteforstuff][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984532/3a33891757fbcd8958fc93070f66c2dc17c84bc5.png[/img][/url]
